findings.evidence: Lines 143–151 and 182–186 prove the public iff normal forms, while neither declaration has an automation attribute; the foundational predicates already expose their defining normal forms as `@[simp]` in `ConditionallyIID/Basic.lean:88` and `MixedIID/Basic.lean:94`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to both terminal `..._iff_iIndepFun` lemmas; leave the intermediate conditional-to-mixed equivalence untagged to avoid a redundant competing rewrite.
findings.issue: The terminal characterizations `mixedIIDWith_const_iff_iIndepFun` (line 143) and `conditionallyIIDWith_const_iff_iIndepFun` (line 182) are not tagged `@[simp]`, so simplification cannot reduce either constant-witness predicate to independence and common marginals.

summary: The characteristic constant-witness API lacks the normal-form automation expected for these equivalences.
